caption: Naya sample poster: 1/2 ki jagah A/B (log mobile number bhej dete the).

text: WhatsApp Business → Quick replies → 'sample': purani photo hata ke ye poster lagao, aur message badlo:
Ye rahe 2 options. Bas ek letter likh ke bhejiye: A (1x1 ft chhota piece, free, sirf delivery) ya B (poori 8x4 sheet, trial rate). Saath mein naam, poora address aur pincode. Phir UPI ID bhejenge.
